* `:source_document_sha256` — the source document's fingerprint, copied
      to the entry as an immutable posting-time snapshot.
    * `:source_file_reuse_confirmed` — `true` only when the reviewer explicitly
      confirmed a reuse of the same file; defaults to `false`.
    * `:booking` — a map with `category`, `need_or_want` and `notes`. When
      given, the entry is categorized and posted in the same multi (step
      `:posted_journal_entry`), so an invoice can be checked and booked in one
      step. Without it the entry stays `uncategorized`.
  """
  @spec create_multi_from_decision(ReviewDecision.t(), map(), keyword()) :: Ecto.Multi.t()
  def create_multi_from_decision(
        %ReviewDecision{} = decision,
        tax_claim_attrs \\ %{},
        opts \\ []
      ) do
    data = decision.decision_data || decision.original_data

    attrs = %{
      review_decision_id: decision.id,
      user_id: decision.user_id,
      amount_cents: data.amount_to_pay_cents,
      currency: data.currency,
      date: parse_date(data.invoice_date),
      description: data.reason_for_payment,
      issuer: data.issuer,
      invoice_number: data.invoice_number,
      status: "uncategorized",
      source_document_sha256: Keyword.get(opts, :source_document_sha256),
      source_file_reuse_confirmed: Keyword.get(opts, :source_file_reuse_confirmed, false)
    }

    tax_claim_attrs = normalize_tax_claim_attrs(attrs.amount_cents, tax_claim_attrs)

    Multi.new()
    |> Multi.insert(:journal_entry, JournalEntry.changeset_for_create(attrs))
    |> Multi.run(:tax_deduction_claim, fn repo, %{journal_entry: entry} ->
      TaxDeductionClaim.changeset_for_create(entry, tax_claim_attrs) |> repo.insert()
    end)
    |> maybe_post_booking(Keyword.get(opts, :booking))
  end

  defp maybe_post_booking(multi, nil), do: multi

  defp maybe_post_booking(multi, booking) when is_map(booking) do
    Multi.update(multi, :posted_journal_entry, fn %{journal_entry: entry} ->
      booking = Map.new(booking, fn {key, value} -> {to_string(key), value} end)

      JournalEntry.changeset_for_categorize(entry, Map.put(booking, "status", "posted"))
    end)
    |> Multi.insert(:posted_event, fn %{posted_journal_entry: entry, tax_deduction_claim: claim} ->
      posted_event_changeset(entry, claim.status)
    end)
  end

  @doc """
  True when a journal-entry insert failed on the unique
  (user, issuer, invoice number) index or the unique (user, source file
  digest) index over unconfirmed postings.

  Matches the constraint name rather than the error message, so unrelated
  changeset errors are never mistaken for a duplicate.
  """
  @spec duplicate_error?(Ecto.Changeset.t()) :: boolean()
  def duplicate_error?(%Ecto.Changeset{errors: errors}) do
    duplicate_indexes = [
      JournalEntry.duplicate_invoice_index(),
      JournalEntry.duplicate_source_file_index()
    ]

    Enum.any?(errors, fn {_field, {_message, opts}} ->
      opts[:constraint] == :unique and opts[:constraint_name] in duplicate_indexes
    end)
  end

  def duplicate_error?(_other), do: false

  @doc """
  Fetches the journal entry created for a review decision, if any.
  """
  @spec get_journal_entry_for_decision(integer() | String.t()) ::
          {:ok, JournalEntry.t()} | :error
  def get_journal_entry_for_decision(review_decision_id) do
    case Repo.get_by(JournalEntry, review_decision_id: review_decision_id) do
      nil ->
        :error

      entry ->
        {:ok, Repo.preload(entry, :tax_deduction_claim)}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  True when `candidates` (from `duplicate_candidates/2` for the same `data`)
  matched on the invoice number — the strong, blocking kind of duplicate.

  Strength follows the rule that matched, which is decided by whether `data`
  has an invoice number; a numbered entry found through the unnumbered tuple
  is only a possible duplicate.
  """
  @spec strong_match?(ExtractedData.t(), [JournalEntry.t()]) :: boolean()
  def strong_match?(%ExtractedData{}, []), do: false

  def strong_match?(%ExtractedData{invoice_number: number}, [_ | _]),
    do: invoice_number?(number)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Posting (category assignment)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  @spec post_entry(JournalEntry.t(), integer(), String.t(), String.t(), String.t() | nil, map()) ::
          {:ok, JournalEntry.t()} | {:error, Ecto.Changeset.t()}
  def post_entry(
        %JournalEntry{} = entry,
        user_id,
        category,
        need_or_want,
        notes \\ nil,
        tax_claim_attrs \\ %{}
      ) do
    true = entry.user_id == user_id

    Multi.new()
    |> Multi.update(
      :journal_entry,
      JournalEntry.changeset_for_categorize(entry, %{
        category: category,
        need_or_want: need_or_want,
        notes: notes,
        status: "posted"
      })
    )
    |> Multi.run(:tax_deduction_claim, fn repo, %{journal_entry: updated} ->
      upsert_tax_deduction_claim(repo, updated, tax_claim_attrs)
    end)
    |> Multi.insert(:posted_event, fn %{journal_entry: updated, tax_deduction_claim: claim} ->
      posted_event_changeset(updated, claim.status)
    end)
    |> Repo.transaction()
    |> case do
      {:ok, %{journal_entry: updated, tax_deduction_claim: claim}} ->
        {:ok, %{updated | tax_deduction_claim: claim}}

      {:error, _operation, changeset, _changes} ->
        {:error, changeset}
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Queries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  @doc """
  Returns posted spending totals for the current UTC month.

  Until currency conversion is introduced, amounts in every source currency
  are treated as equivalent and displayed using the user's base currency.
  """
  def current_month_spending(%Scope{} = scope) do
    current_month_spending(scope, Date.utc_today())
  end

  @doc """
  Returns posted spending totals for the month containing `reference_date`.

  The explicit date keeps month-boundary behavior deterministic for callers
  such as tests and historical reports.
  """
  def current_month_spending(%Scope{} = scope, %Date{} = reference_date) do
    monthly_spending(scope, reference_date)
  end

  @doc """
  Returns posted spending totals for the month containing `reference_date`.
  """
  def monthly_spending(%Scope{user: user}, %Date{} = reference_date) do
    user_id = user.id
    month_start = Date.beginning_of_month(reference_date)
    next_month_start = month_start |> Date.add(32) |> Date.beginning_of_month()

    categories =
      from(je in JournalEntry,
        where:
          je.user_id == ^user_id and
            je.status == "posted" and
            not is_nil(je.category) and
            fragment("btrim(?) <> ''", je.category) and
            je.date >= ^month_start and
            je.date < ^next_month_start,
        group_by: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", je.category),
        order_by: [desc: sum(je.amount_cents)],
        select: %{
          category: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", je.category),
          total_cents: sum(je.amount_cents),
          entry_count: count(je.id)
        }
      )
      |> Repo.all()
      |> Enum.map(fn category ->
        %{category | category: humanize_category(category.category)}
      end)

    %{
      month_start: month_start,
      currency: user.base_currency,
      total_cents: Enum.sum_by(categories, & &1.total_cents),
      entry_count: Enum.sum_by(categories, & &1.entry_count),
      categories: categories
    }
  end

  @doc """
  Returns the distinct categories the scoped user has already assigned, sorted
  alphabetically, for autocompleting the posting form.

  Categories differing only in case or surrounding whitespace collapse into
  one suggestion spelled as most recently used. Other users' categories are
  never returned.
  """
  @spec list_categories(Scope.t()) :: [String.t()]
  def list_categories(%Scope{user: user}) do
    from(je in JournalEntry,
      where:
        je.user_id == ^user.id and
          not is_nil(je.category) and
          fragment("btrim(?) <> ''", je.category),
      distinct: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", je.category),
      # DISTINCT ON keeps the first row per key, so newest first picks the latest spelling.
      order_by: [desc: je.updated_at, desc: je.id],
      select: fragment("btrim(?)", je.category)
    )
    |> Repo.all()
  end

  @spec list_journal_entries(integer()) :: [JournalEntry.t()]
  def list_journal_entries(user_id) do
    from(je in JournalEntry,
      where: je.user_id == ^user_id,
      preload: [:tax_deduction_claim],
      order_by: [
        desc: je.updated_at,
        desc: je.id
      ]
    )
    |> Repo.all()
  end

  @spec get_journal_entry(integer(), integer()) :: {:ok, JournalEntry.t()} | {:error, String.t()}
  def get_journal_entry(id, user_id) do
    case Repo.one(
           from je in JournalEntry,
             where: je.id == ^id and je.user_id == ^user_id,
             preload: [:tax_deduction_claim]
         ) do
      nil -> {:error, "Journal entry not found or not owned by user"}
      entry -> {:ok, entry}
    end
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private helpers
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  defp humanize_category(category) do
    category
    |> String.split(~r/\s+/, trim: true)
    |> Enum.map_join(" ", &capitalize_word/1)
  end

  defp capitalize_word(word) do
    case String.next_grapheme(word) do
      {first, rest} -> String.upcase(first) <> rest
      nil -> word
    end
  end

  defp parse_date(nil), do: nil

  defp parse_date(str) when is_binary(str) do
    case Date.from_iso8601(str) do
      {:ok, date} -> date
      {:error, _} -> nil
    end
  end

  defp upsert_tax_deduction_claim(repo, %JournalEntry{} = entry, attrs) do
    attrs = normalize_tax_claim_attrs(entry.amount_cents, attrs)

    case repo.get_by(TaxDeductionClaim, journal_entry_id: entry.id) do
      nil ->
        TaxDeductionClaim.changeset_for_create(entry, attrs) |> repo.insert()

      claim ->
        TaxDeductionClaim.changeset_for_update(claim, attrs) |> repo.update()
    end
  end

  defp normalize_tax_claim_attrs(amount_cents, attrs) do
    attrs = Map.new(attrs, fn {key, value} -> {to_string(key), value} end)
    status = Map.get(attrs, "status", "undecided")

    Map.put_new_lazy(attrs, "deductible_amount_cents", fn ->
      if status in ["not_deductible", "disallowed"], do: 0, else: amount_cents
    end)
  end

  @doc """
  Builds the `journal_entry_posted` audit event for a booked `entry`.

  Every way of booking an entry writes this event in the booking's transaction.
  `details` adds path-specific metadata, such as how a backfill chose the values.
  """
  @spec posted_event_changeset(JournalEntry.t(), String.t() | nil, map()) :: Ecto.Changeset.t()
  def posted_event_changeset(%JournalEntry{} = entry, tax_status, details \\ %{}) do
    EventLog.changeset_for_create(%{
      event_type: "journal_entry_posted",
      invoice_id: to_string(entry.id),
      user_id: entry.user_id,
      status: "completed",
      metadata:
        Map.merge(details, %{
          category: entry.category,
          need_or_want: entry.need_or_want,
          tax_deduction_status: tax_status
        })
    })
  end
end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Review do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Context for reviewing OCR/LLM processed invoice data.
4	
5	  Handles approve / reject / amend decisions on extracted invoices.
6	  Each decision updates a single ReviewDecision row in place and appends
7	  an immutable entry to EventLog for audit purposes.
8	  """
9	
10	  import Ecto.Query, warn: false
11	  require Logger
12	
13	  alias Ecto.Multi
14	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting
15	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope
16	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
17	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedData
18	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
19	  alias ZaimuTomo.Langfuse
20	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
21	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.EventLog
22	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
23	
24	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
25	  # Initial decision creation (called by OCR worker)
26	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
27	
28	  def create_initial_decision(%ExtractedContent{} = content) do
29	    ReviewDecision.changeset_for_create(%{
30	      extracted_content_id: content.id,
31	      user_id: content.user_id,
32	      review_status: "pending",
33	      decision_type: "initial",
34	      original_data: content.extracted_data
35	    })
36	    |> Repo.insert()
37	  end
38	
39	  def create_failed_decision(%ExtractedContent{} = content, error) do
40	    ReviewDecision.changeset_for_create(%{
41	      extracted_content_id: content.id,
42	      user_id: content.user_id,
43	      review_status: "failed",
44	      decision_type: "failed",
45	      review_notes: failure_review_note(error)
46	    })
47	    |> Repo.insert()
48	  end
49	
50	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
51	  # Human review actions
52	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
53	
54	  @doc """
55	  Approves a pending invoice and posts its journal entry in one transaction.
56	
57	  Options:
58	
59	    * `:confirm_file_reuse` — `true` when the reviewer explicitly confirmed
60	      that the source file is a legitimate reuse (for example, a reused
61	      QR-bill) of an already posted file. Honored only when the duplicate
62	      check's verdict is `:file_reuse`; see `post_review_transaction/6`.
63	    * `:booking` — `%{category, need_or_want, notes}`; when given, the journal
64	      entry is created already categorized and posted instead of
65	      `uncategorized`, in the same transaction.
66	    * `:tax_claim_attrs` — attributes for the entry's tax deduction claim,
67	      such as `%{"status" => "candidate"}`; defaults to undecided.
68	
69	  Returns `{:error, :duplicate_invoice}` when a duplicate blocks the posting
70	  and `{:error, :file_reuse_not_applicable}` when a reuse was confirmed but
71	  no confirmable file match exists.
72	  """
73	  def approve_invoice(extracted_content_id, user_id, notes \\ nil, opts \\ []) do
74	    with {:ok, decision} <- get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id) do
75	      post_review_transaction(
76	        decision,
77	        %{
78	          review_status: "approved",
79	          decision_type: "approved",
80	          review_notes: notes,
81	          review_completed_at: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.truncate(:second)
82	        },
83	        "invoice_approved",
84	        %{notes: notes},
85	        "approved",
86	        opts
87	      )
88	    end
89	  end
90	
91	  def reject_invoice(extracted_content_id, user_id, rejection_reason, notes \\ nil) do
92	    with {:ok, decision} <- get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id),
93	         {:ok, updated} <-
94	           update_review_decision(decision, %{
95	             review_status: "rejected",
96	             decision_type: "rejected",
97	             rejection_reason: rejection_reason,
98	             review_notes: notes,
99	             review_completed_at: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.truncate(:second)
100	           }) do
101	      write_event_log("invoice_rejected", extracted_content_id, user_id, %{
102	        rejection_reason: rejection_reason,
103	        notes: notes
104	      })
105	
106	      emit_review_completed_event(updated, "rejected")
107	      {:ok, updated}
108	    end
109	  end
110	
111	  @doc """
112	  Amends a pending invoice and posts its journal entry in one transaction.
113	
114	  Accepts the same options and errors as `approve_invoice/4`. The duplicate
115	  check runs on the amended facts, so correcting the date of a reused slip can
116	  turn a blocked exact-file match into a confirmable one.
117	  """
118	  def amend_invoice(extracted_content_id, user_id, amended_data, notes \\ nil, opts \\ []) do
119	    with {:ok, decision} <- get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id) do
120	      post_review_transaction(
121	        decision,
122	        %{
123	          review_status: "amended",
124	          decision_type: "amended",
125	          status: "completed",
126	          decision_data: amended_data,
127	          review_notes: notes,
128	          review_completed_at: NaiveDateTime.utc_now() |> NaiveDateTime.truncate(:second)
129	        },
130	        "invoice_amended",
131	        %{amended_data: amended_data, notes: notes},
132	        "amended",
133	        opts
134	      )
135	    end
136	  end
137	
138	  @doc """
139	  Scores the extraction of an invoice that was just posted, in the background.
140	
141	  Without an explicit `override` (`0` or `1`), the score is `1` when the
142	  invoice was posted as extracted and `0` when fields were corrected. The
143	  comment lists the corrected fields with their extracted and posted values;
144	  the reviewer's own comment is never sent. A no-op without a Langfuse trace.
145	  """
146	  @spec score_posted_extraction(ExtractedContent.t(), [{atom(), term(), term()}], 0 | 1 | nil) ::
147	          :ok
148	  def score_posted_extraction(content, changes, override \\ nil)
149	
150	  def score_posted_extraction(%ExtractedContent{trace_id: trace_id}, changes, override)
151	      when is_binary(trace_id) do
152	    value = override || if(changes == [], do: 1, else: 0)
153	
154	    comment =
155	      if changes != [] do
156	        "Corrected before posting: " <>
157	          Enum.map_join(changes, "; ", fn {field, from, to} ->
158	            "#{field} #{inspect(from)} -> #{inspect(to)}"
159	          end)
160	      end
161	
162	    send_extraction_score(trace_id, value, comment)
163	  end
164	
165	  def score_posted_extraction(_content, _changes, _override), do: :ok
166	
167	  @doc """
168	  Records the reviewer's explicit 👍/👎 (`1` or `0`) when rejecting an invoice,
169	  in the background. A rejection alone says nothing about the extraction (a
170	  correctly read duplicate is rejected too), so without a choice nothing is sent.
171	  The rejection reason is never sent.
172	  """
173	  @spec score_rejected_extraction(ExtractedContent.t(), 0 | 1 | nil) :: :ok
174	  def score_rejected_extraction(%ExtractedContent{trace_id: trace_id}, value)
175	      when is_binary(trace_id) and value in [0, 1] do
176	    send_extraction_score(trace_id, value, "Rejected before posting")
177	  end
178	
179	  def score_rejected_extraction(_content, _value), do: :ok
180	
181	  defp send_extraction_score(trace_id, value, comment) do
182	    Task.start(fn ->
183	      with {:error, reason} <- Langfuse.create_user_score(trace_id, value, comment) do
184	        Logger.warning("Failed to record extraction score: #{inspect(reason)}")
185	      end
186	    end)
187	
188	    :ok
189	  end
190	
191	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
192	  # Queries
193	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
194	
195	  @doc """
196	  Runs `Accounting.duplicate_check/3` for a review decision against `data`
197	  (its effective data, or amended data not yet saved), using the source
198	  document's fingerprint loaded through the decision's own user scope.
199	
200	  The fingerprint itself never leaves the server-side contexts.
201	  """
202	  @spec duplicate_check(ReviewDecision.t(), ExtractedData.t()) :: Accounting.duplicate_check()
203	  def duplicate_check(%ReviewDecision{} = decision, %ExtractedData{} = data) do
204	    Accounting.duplicate_check(decision.user_id, data, source_document_sha256(Repo, decision))
205	  end
206	
207	  def get_review_decision(id, user_id) do
208	    query =
209	      from rd in ReviewDecision,
210	        join: ec in ExtractedContent,
211	        on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id,
212	        where: rd.id == ^id,
213	        where: ec.user_id == ^user_id,
214	        preload: [extracted_content: ec]
215	
216	    case Repo.one(query) do
217	      nil -> {:error, "Review decision not found or not owned by user"}
218	      review_decision -> {:ok, review_decision}
219	    end
220	  end
221	
222	  @doc """
223	  Returns the number of the user's reviews awaiting a decision.
224	  """
225	  def pending_review_count(%Scope{} = scope) do
226	    from(rd in ReviewDecision,
227	      where: rd.user_id == ^scope.user.id,
228	      where: rd.review_status == "pending",
229	      select: count(rd.id)
230	    )
231	    |> Repo.one()
232	  end
233	
234	  def get_review_status_counts(user_id) do
235	    ReviewDecision
236	    |> join(:left, [rd], ec in ExtractedContent, on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id)
237	    |> where(
238	      [rd, ec],
239	      ec.user_id == ^user_id and
240	        rd.review_status in ["pending", "approved", "rejected", "amended"]
241	    )
242	    |> group_by([rd, _], rd.review_status)
243	    |> select([rd, _], %{status: rd.review_status, count: count(rd.id)})
244	    |> Repo.all()
245	    |> Enum.into(%{}, fn %{status: status, count: count} -> {String.to_atom(status), count} end)
246	  end
247	
248	  def update_review_decision(%ReviewDecision{} = review_decision, attrs) do
249	    review_decision
250	    |> ReviewDecision.changeset_for_update(attrs)
251	    |> Repo.update()
252	  end
253	
254	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
255	  # Private helpers
256	  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
257	
258	  defp failure_review_note({type, _reason}) when is_atom(type),
259	    do: "Automatically marked as failed: #{type}"
260	
261	  defp failure_review_note(type) when is_atom(type),
262	    do: "Automatically marked as failed: #{type}"
263	
264	  defp failure_review_note(_error), do: "Automatically marked as failed: unknown error"
265	
266	  defp get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id) do
267	    query =
268	      from rd in ReviewDecision,
269	        join: ec in ExtractedContent,
270	        on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id,
271	        where: rd.extracted_content_id == ^extracted_content_id,
272	        where: ec.user_id == ^user_id,
273	        where: rd.review_status == "pending"
274	
275	    case Repo.one(query) do
276	      nil -> {:error, "No pending review found for this invoice"}
277	      decision -> {:ok, decision}
278	    end
279	  end
280	
281	  # Marks a pending review as approved or amended and posts its journal entry in
282	  # ONE transaction.
283	  #
284	  # The journal entry is created from the decision's effective data (amended data
285	  # when present, original otherwise) in the same transaction that updates the
286	  # review, and carries the source document's fingerprint. A duplicate invoice —
287	  # enforced by the unique (user, issuer, invoice number) index or the unique
288	  # (user, source file digest) index over unconfirmed postings — rolls the whole
289	  # transition back and the review stays pending. Returns
290	  # `{:error, :duplicate_invoice}` in that case, `{:error, changeset}` for other
291	  # failures.
292	  #
293	  # With `confirm_file_reuse: true`, the duplicate check is re-run inside the
294	  # transaction on the effective data. Only a `:file_reuse` verdict marks the
295	  # entry `source_file_reuse_confirmed` and records the confirmation with the
296	  # matched entry IDs in the event log; a blocked verdict is refused as a
297	  # duplicate, and any other verdict as `:file_reuse_not_applicable`, so a
298	  # confirmation is never inferred or applied to the wrong match.
299	  defp post_review_transaction(
300	         decision,
301	         changeset_attrs,
302	         event_type,
303	         event_metadata,
304	         status,
305	         opts
306	       ) do
307	    confirm_file_reuse? = Keyword.get(opts, :confirm_file_reuse, false) == true
308	
309	    booking = Keyword.get(opts, :booking)
310	    tax_claim_attrs = Keyword.get(opts, :tax_claim_attrs, %{})
311	
312	    event_metadata =
313	      if booking,
314	        do: Map.merge(event_metadata, %{booking: booking, tax_claim: tax_claim_attrs}),
315	        else: event_metadata
316	
317	    Multi.new()
318	    |> Multi.run(:source_document_sha256, fn repo, _changes ->
319	      {:ok, source_document_sha256(repo, decision)}

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Review do
  @moduledoc """
  Context for reviewing OCR/LLM processed invoice data.

  Handles approve / reject / amend decisions on extracted invoices.
  Each decision updates a single ReviewDecision row in place and appends
  an immutable entry to EventLog for audit purposes.
  """

  import Ecto.Query, warn: false
  require Logger

  alias Ecto.Multi
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedData
  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
  alias ZaimuTomo.Langfuse
  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.EventLog
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Initial decision creation (called by OCR worker)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  def create_initial_decision(%ExtractedContent{} = content) do
    ReviewDecision.changeset_for_create(%{
      extracted_content_id: content.id,
      user_id: content.user_id,
      review_status: "pending",
      decision_type: "initial",
      original_data: content.extracted_data
    })
    |> Repo.insert()
  end

  def create_failed_decision(%ExtractedContent{} = content, error) do
    ReviewDecision.changeset_for_create(%{
      extracted_content_id: content.id,
      user_id: content.user_id,
      review_status: "failed",
      decision_type: "failed",
      review_notes: failure_review_note(error)
    })
    |> Repo.insert()
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Human review actions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  @doc """
  Approves a pending invoice and posts its journal entry in one transaction.

  Options:

    * `:confirm_file_reuse` — `true` when the reviewer explicitly confirmed
      that the source file is a legitimate reuse (for example, a reused
      QR-bill) of an already posted file. Honored only when the duplicate
      check's verdict is `:file_reuse`; see `post_review_transaction/6`.
    * `:booking` — `%{category, need_or_want, notes}`; when given, the journal
      entry is created already categorized and posted instead of
      `uncategorized`, in the same transaction.
    * `:tax_claim_attrs` — attributes for the entry's tax deduction claim,
      such as `%{"status" => "candidate"}`; defaults to undecided.

  Returns `{:error, :duplicate_invoice}` when a duplicate blocks the posting
  and `{:error, :file_reuse_not_applicable}` when a reuse was confirmed but
  no confirmable file match exists.
  """
  def approve_invoice(extracted_content_id, user_id, notes \\ nil, opts \\ []) do
    with {:ok, decision} <- get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id) do
      post_review_transaction(
        decision,
        %{
          review_status: "approved",
          decision_type: "approved",
          review_notes: notes,
          review_completed_at: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.truncate(:second)
        },
        "invoice_approved",
        %{notes: notes},
        "approved",
        opts
      )
    end
  end

  def reject_invoice(extracted_content_id, user_id, rejection_reason, notes \\ nil) do
    with {:ok, decision} <- get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id),
         {:ok, updated} <-
           update_review_decision(decision, %{
             review_status: "rejected",
             decision_type: "rejected",
             rejection_reason: rejection_reason,
             review_notes: notes,
             review_completed_at: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.truncate(:second)
           }) do
      write_event_log("invoice_rejected", extracted_content_id, user_id, %{
        rejection_reason: rejection_reason,
        notes: notes
      })

      emit_review_completed_event(updated, "rejected")
      {:ok, updated}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Amends a pending invoice and posts its journal entry in one transaction.

  Accepts the same options and errors as `approve_invoice/4`. The duplicate
  check runs on the amended facts, so correcting the date of a reused slip can
  turn a blocked exact-file match into a confirmable one.
  """
  def amend_invoice(extracted_content_id, user_id, amended_data, notes \\ nil, opts \\ []) do
    with {:ok, decision} <- get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id) do
      post_review_transaction(
        decision,
        %{
          review_status: "amended",
          decision_type: "amended",
          status: "completed",
          decision_data: amended_data,
          review_notes: notes,
          review_completed_at: NaiveDateTime.utc_now() |> NaiveDateTime.truncate(:second)
        },
        "invoice_amended",
        %{amended_data: amended_data, notes: notes},
        "amended",
        opts
      )
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Scores the extraction of an invoice that was just posted, in the background.

  Without an explicit `override` (`0` or `1`), the score is `1` when the
  invoice was posted as extracted and `0` when fields were corrected. The
  comment lists the corrected fields with their extracted and posted values;
  the reviewer's own comment is never sent. A no-op without a Langfuse trace.
  """
  @spec score_posted_extraction(ExtractedContent.t(), [{atom(), term(), term()}], 0 | 1 | nil) ::
          :ok
  def score_posted_extraction(content, changes, override \\ nil)

  def score_posted_extraction(%ExtractedContent{trace_id: trace_id}, changes, override)
      when is_binary(trace_id) do
    value = override || if(changes == [], do: 1, else: 0)

    comment =
      if changes != [] do
        "Corrected before posting: " <>
          Enum.map_join(changes, "; ", fn {field, from, to} ->
            "#{field} #{inspect(from)} -> #{inspect(to)}"
          end)
      end

    send_extraction_score(trace_id, value, comment)
  end

  def score_posted_extraction(_content, _changes, _override), do: :ok

  @doc """
  Records the reviewer's explicit 👍/👎 (`1` or `0`) when rejecting an invoice,
  in the background. A rejection alone says nothing about the extraction (a
  correctly read duplicate is rejected too), so without a choice nothing is sent.
  The rejection reason is never sent.
  """
  @spec score_rejected_extraction(ExtractedContent.t(), 0 | 1 | nil) :: :ok
  def score_rejected_extraction(%ExtractedContent{trace_id: trace_id}, value)
      when is_binary(trace_id) and value in [0, 1] do
    send_extraction_score(trace_id, value, "Rejected before posting")
  end

  def score_rejected_extraction(_content, _value), do: :ok

  defp send_extraction_score(trace_id, value, comment) do
    Task.start(fn ->
      with {:error, reason} <- Langfuse.create_user_score(trace_id, value, comment) do
        Logger.warning("Failed to record extraction score: #{inspect(reason)}")
      end
    end)

    :ok
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Queries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  @doc """
  Runs `Accounting.duplicate_check/3` for a review decision against `data`
  (its effective data, or amended data not yet saved), using the source
  document's fingerprint loaded through the decision's own user scope.

  The fingerprint itself never leaves the server-side contexts.
  """
  @spec duplicate_check(ReviewDecision.t(), ExtractedData.t()) :: Accounting.duplicate_check()
  def duplicate_check(%ReviewDecision{} = decision, %ExtractedData{} = data) do
    Accounting.duplicate_check(decision.user_id, data, source_document_sha256(Repo, decision))
  end

  def get_review_decision(id, user_id) do
    query =
      from rd in ReviewDecision,
        join: ec in ExtractedContent,
        on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id,
        where: rd.id == ^id,
        where: ec.user_id == ^user_id,
        preload: [extracted_content: ec]

    case Repo.one(query) do
      nil -> {:error, "Review decision not found or not owned by user"}
      review_decision -> {:ok, review_decision}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Returns the number of the user's reviews awaiting a decision.
  """
  def pending_review_count(%Scope{} = scope) do
    from(rd in ReviewDecision,
      where: rd.user_id == ^scope.user.id,
      where: rd.review_status == "pending",
      select: count(rd.id)
    )
    |> Repo.one()
  end

  def get_review_status_counts(user_id) do
    ReviewDecision
    |> join(:left, [rd], ec in ExtractedContent, on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id)
    |> where(
      [rd, ec],
      ec.user_id == ^user_id and
        rd.review_status in ["pending", "approved", "rejected", "amended"]
    )
    |> group_by([rd, _], rd.review_status)
    |> select([rd, _], %{status: rd.review_status, count: count(rd.id)})
    |> Repo.all()
    |> Enum.into(%{}, fn %{status: status, count: count} -> {String.to_atom(status), count} end)
  end

  def update_review_decision(%ReviewDecision{} = review_decision, attrs) do
    review_decision
    |> ReviewDecision.changeset_for_update(attrs)
    |> Repo.update()
  end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private helpers
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  defp failure_review_note({type, _reason}) when is_atom(type),
    do: "Automatically marked as failed: #{type}"

  defp failure_review_note(type) when is_atom(type),
    do: "Automatically marked as failed: #{type}"

  defp failure_review_note(_error), do: "Automatically marked as failed: unknown error"

  defp get_pending_decision(extracted_content_id, user_id) do
    query =
      from rd in ReviewDecision,
        join: ec in ExtractedContent,
        on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id,
        where: rd.extracted_content_id == ^extracted_content_id,
        where: ec.user_id == ^user_id,
        where: rd.review_status == "pending"

    case Repo.one(query) do
      nil -> {:error, "No pending review found for this invoice"}
      decision -> {:ok, decision}
    end
  end

  # Marks a pending review as approved or amended and posts its journal entry in
  # ONE transaction.
  #
  # The journal entry is created from the decision's effective data (amended data
  # when present, original otherwise) in the same transaction that updates the
  # review, and carries the source document's fingerprint. A duplicate invoice —
  # enforced by the unique (user, issuer, invoice number) index or the unique
  # (user, source file digest) index over unconfirmed postings — rolls the whole
  # transition back and the review stays pending. Returns
  # `{:error, :duplicate_invoice}` in that case, `{:error, changeset}` for other
  # failures.
  #
  # With `confirm_file_reuse: true`, the duplicate check is re-run inside the
  # transaction on the effective data. Only a `:file_reuse` verdict marks the
  # entry `source_file_reuse_confirmed` and records the confirmation with the
  # matched entry IDs in the event log; a blocked verdict is refused as a
  # duplicate, and any other verdict as `:file_reuse_not_applicable`, so a
  # confirmation is never inferred or applied to the wrong match.
  defp post_review_transaction(
         decision,
         changeset_attrs,
         event_type,
         event_metadata,
         status,
         opts
       ) do
    confirm_file_reuse? = Keyword.get(opts, :confirm_file_reuse, false) == true

    booking = Keyword.get(opts, :booking)
    tax_claim_attrs = Keyword.get(opts, :tax_claim_attrs, %{})

    event_metadata =
      if booking,
        do: Map.merge(event_metadata, %{booking: booking, tax_claim: tax_claim_attrs}),
        else: event_metadata

    Multi.new()
    |> Multi.run(:source_document_sha256, fn repo, _changes ->
      {:ok, source_document_sha256(repo, decision)}
    end)
    |> Multi.update(
      :review_decision,
      ReviewDecision.changeset_for_update(decision, changeset_attrs)
    )
    |> Multi.run(:file_reuse, fn _repo, changes ->
      file_reuse_confirmation(confirm_file_reuse?, changes)
    end)
    |> Multi.merge(fn %{review_decision: updated} = changes ->
      Accounting.create_multi_from_decision(updated, tax_claim_attrs,
        source_document_sha256: changes.source_document_sha256,
        source_file_reuse_confirmed: changes.file_reuse != nil,
        booking: booking
      )
    end)
    |> Multi.run(:event_log, fn repo, %{review_decision: updated} ->
      insert_event_log(
        repo,
        event_type,
        updated.extracted_content_id,
        updated.user_id,
        event_metadata
      )
    end)
    |> Multi.run(:file_reuse_event_log, fn repo, changes ->
      insert_file_reuse_event_log(repo, changes)
    end)
    |> Repo.transaction()
    |> case do
      {:ok, %{review_decision: updated}} ->
        emit_review_completed_event(updated, status)
        {:ok, updated}

      {:error, :file_reuse, reason, _changes} ->
        {:error, reason}

      {:error, :journal_entry, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset, _changes} ->
        if Accounting.duplicate_error?(changeset) do
          {:error, :duplicate_invoice}
        else
          {:error, changeset}
        end

      {:error, _operation, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset, _changes} ->
        {:error, changeset}
    end
  end

  defp file_reuse_confirmation(false, _changes), do: {:ok, nil}

  defp file_reuse_confirmation(true, %{
         review_decision: updated,
         source_document_sha256: source_sha256
       }) do
    check =
      Accounting.duplicate_check(
        updated.user_id,
        ReviewDecision.effective_data(updated),
        source_sha256
      )

    case check.verdict do
      :file_reuse ->
        {:ok, %{matched_journal_entry_ids: Enum.map(check.candidates, & &1.entry.id)}}

      verdict when verdict in [:invoice_number, :same_file_blocked] ->
        {:error, :duplicate_invoice}

      _no_file_match ->
        {:error, :file_reuse_not_applicable}
    end
  end

  defp insert_file_reuse_event_log(_repo, %{file_reuse: nil}), do: {:ok, nil}

  defp insert_file_reuse_event_log(repo, %{
         file_reuse: %{matched_journal_entry_ids: [matched_id | _] = matched_ids},
         journal_entry: entry,
         review_decision: updated
       }) do
    insert_event_log(
      repo,
      "source_file_reuse_confirmed",
      updated.extracted_content_id,
      updated.user_id,
      %{
        journal_entry_id: entry.id,
        matched_journal_entry_id: matched_id,
        matched_journal_entry_ids: matched_ids
      }
    )
  end

  # Loads the decision's source document fingerprint, scoped to the decision's
  # user through both the extraction and the document.
  defp source_document_sha256(repo, %ReviewDecision{} = decision) do
    from(ec in ExtractedContent,
      join: d in Document,
      on: d.id == ec.document_id,
      where: ec.id == ^decision.extracted_content_id,
      where: ec.user_id == ^decision.user_id and d.user_id == ^decision.user_id,
      select: d.content_sha256
    )
    |> repo.one()
  end

  # Best-effort audit write for transitions that do not post a journal entry.
  defp write_event_log(event_type, invoice_id, user_id, metadata) do
    case insert_event_log(Repo, event_type, invoice_id, user_id, metadata) do
      {:ok, _event_log} ->
        :ok

      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warning("Failed to write event log for #{event_type}: #{inspect(reason)}")
        :ok
    end
  end

  # Inside the posting transaction the audit entry is required: an error
  # rolls back the review update and the journal entry with it.
  defp insert_event_log(repo, event_type, invoice_id, user_id, metadata) do
    %{
      event_type: event_type,
      invoice_id: to_string(invoice_id),
      user_id: user_id,
      metadata: metadata,
      status: "completed"
    }
    |> EventLog.changeset_for_create()
    |> repo.insert()
  end

  defp emit_review_completed_event(%ReviewDecision{} = decision, status) do
    Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, "invoice_review:completed", %{
      invoice_id: decision.extracted_content_id,
      status: status,
      user_id: decision.user_id,
      decision_data: decision.decision_data,
      timestamp: DateTime.utc_now()
    })
  end
end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting.LegacyBookingBackfill do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  One-off backfill for journal entries that predate booking at posting time and
4	  are still missing a category or a need/want choice.
5	
6	  An entry is completed only when the same user's posted entries from the same
7	  issuer (compared like the duplicate index, trimmed and case-insensitive) agree
8	  on every missing value. Values the entry already has are kept. Anything else
9	  is reported for a person to book, so nothing is guessed from a similar name.
10	
11	  Bookings a person already decided are passed at run time as `:manual`, so no
12	  real ledger data lives in the repository. They are keyed by entry ID and
13	  normalized issuer so they cannot land on another row, and go through
14	  `Accounting.post_entry/6`, exactly like the invoice page's Book form.
15	
16	  It is a dry run unless called with `confirm: true`. Each entry is updated in
17	  its own transaction together with a `journal_entry_posted` event marked with
18	  `source: "legacy_booking_backfill"` that records the prior state. For those copied bookings, tax claims and notes
19	  are left alone, and `updated_at` is kept so old entries do not jump to the top
20	  of the journal.
21	  """
22	
23	  import Ecto.Query, warn: false
24	
25	  alias Ecto.Multi
26	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting
27	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
28	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim
29	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
30	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
31	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
32	
33	  @source "legacy_booking_backfill"
34	
35	  @type match :: %{
36	          required(:entry) => JournalEntry.t(),
37	          required(:document_id) => integer(),
38	          required(:category) => String.t(),
39	          required(:need_or_want) => String.t(),
40	          required(:source) => :precedent | :manual,
41	          optional(:precedent_count) => pos_integer(),
42	          optional(:tax_status) => String.t() | nil
43	        }
44	
45	  @type unmatched :: %{
46	          entry: JournalEntry.t(),
47	          document_id: integer(),
48	          reason: :no_history | :conflicting_history
49	        }
50	
51	  @type summary :: %{
52	          confirmed: boolean(),
53	          matched: [match()],
54	          applied: [match()],
55	          unmatched: [unmatched()],
56	          failed: [%{match: match(), errors: term()}]
57	        }
58	
59	  @doc """
60	  Plans the backfill and, with `confirm: true`, applies it.
61	
62	  Returns `{:error, summary}` only when an update failed. Unmatched entries are
63	  expected and left for manual booking.
64	
65	  Options:
66	
67	    * `:confirm` - apply the plan instead of only reporting it.
68	    * `:manual` - decided bookings as a map of `{entry_id, normalized_issuer}`
69	      to `%{category: _, need_or_want: _, tax_status: _}`. Defaults to none.
70	  """
71	  @spec run(keyword()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
72	  def run(opts \\ []) do
73	    confirmed = Keyword.get(opts, :confirm, false)

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting.LegacyBookingBackfill do
  @moduledoc """
  One-off backfill for journal entries that predate booking at posting time and
  are still missing a category or a need/want choice.

  An entry is completed only when the same user's posted entries from the same
  issuer (compared like the duplicate index, trimmed and case-insensitive) agree
  on every missing value. Values the entry already has are kept. Anything else
  is reported for a person to book, so nothing is guessed from a similar name.

  Bookings a person already decided are passed at run time as `:manual`, so no
  real ledger data lives in the repository. They are keyed by entry ID and
  normalized issuer so they cannot land on another row, and go through
  `Accounting.post_entry/6`, exactly like the invoice page's Book form.

  It is a dry run unless called with `confirm: true`. Each entry is updated in
  its own transaction together with a `journal_entry_posted` event marked with
  `source: "legacy_booking_backfill"` that records the prior state. For those copied bookings, tax claims and notes
  are left alone, and `updated_at` is kept so old entries do not jump to the top
  of the journal.
  """

  import Ecto.Query, warn: false

  alias Ecto.Multi
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision

  @source "legacy_booking_backfill"

  @type match :: %{
          required(:entry) => JournalEntry.t(),
          required(:document_id) => integer(),
          required(:category) => String.t(),
          required(:need_or_want) => String.t(),
          required(:source) => :precedent | :manual,
          optional(:precedent_count) => pos_integer(),
          optional(:tax_status) => String.t() | nil
        }

  @type unmatched :: %{
          entry: JournalEntry.t(),
          document_id: integer(),
          reason: :no_history | :conflicting_history
        }

  @type summary :: %{
          confirmed: boolean(),
          matched: [match()],
          applied: [match()],
          unmatched: [unmatched()],
          failed: [%{match: match(), errors: term()}]
        }

  @doc """
  Plans the backfill and, with `confirm: true`, applies it.

  Returns `{:error, summary}` only when an update failed. Unmatched entries are
  expected and left for manual booking.

  Options:

    * `:confirm` - apply the plan instead of only reporting it.
    * `:manual` - decided bookings as a map of `{entry_id, normalized_issuer}`
      to `%{category: _, need_or_want: _, tax_status: _}`. Defaults to none.
  """
  @spec run(keyword()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
  def run(opts \\ []) do
    confirmed = Keyword.get(opts, :confirm, false)
    %{matched: matched, unmatched: unmatched} = plan(Keyword.get(opts, :manual, %{}))
    %{applied: applied, failed: failed} = apply_matches(matched, confirmed)

    summary = %{
      confirmed: confirmed,
      matched: matched,
      applied: applied,
      unmatched: unmatched,
      failed: failed
    }

    {if(failed == [], do: :ok, else: :error), summary}
  end

  @spec format_summary(summary()) :: String.t()
  def format_summary(summary) do
    verb = if summary.confirmed, do: "Booked", else: "Would book"
    mode = if summary.confirmed, do: "applied", else: "dry run"

    [
      "Legacy booking backfill (#{mode}): matched=#{length(summary.matched)} " <>
        "applied=#{length(summary.applied)} unmatched=#{length(summary.unmatched)} " <>
        "failed=#{length(summary.failed)}",
      Enum.map(summary.matched, &format_match(&1, verb)),
      Enum.map(summary.unmatched, &format_unmatched/1),
      Enum.map(summary.failed, &format_failure/1),
      if(summary.confirmed, do: [], else: "Nothing changed. Re-run with confirm: true to apply.")
    ]
    |> List.flatten()
    |> Enum.join("\n")
  end

  defp plan(manual) do
    precedents = precedents()

    targets()
    |> Enum.map(&classify(&1, precedents, manual))
    |> Enum.group_by(&elem(&1, 0), &elem(&1, 1))
    |> then(&%{matched: Map.get(&1, :matched, []), unmatched: Map.get(&1, :unmatched, [])})
  end

  defp targets do
    Repo.all(
      from e in JournalEntry,
        join: d in ReviewDecision,
        on: d.id == e.review_decision_id,
        join: c in ExtractedContent,
        on: c.id == d.extracted_content_id,
        left_join: t in TaxDeductionClaim,
        on: t.journal_entry_id == e.id,
        where: is_nil(e.category) or is_nil(e.need_or_want),
        order_by: e.id,
        select: %{
          entry: e,
          document_id: c.document_id,
          tax_status: t.status,
          issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer)
        }
    )
  end

  defp precedents do
    from(e in JournalEntry,
      where: e.status == "posted",
      where: not is_nil(e.category) and not is_nil(e.need_or_want),
      where: fragment("btrim(?) <> ''", e.issuer),
      group_by: [e.user_id, fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer), e.category, e.need_or_want],
      select: %{
        user_id: e.user_id,
        issuer_key: fragment("lower(btrim(?))", e.issuer),
        category: e.category,
        need_or_want: e.need_or_want,
        count: count(e.id)
      }
    )
    |> Repo.all()
    |> Enum.group_by(&{&1.user_id, &1.issuer_key})
  end

  defp classify(%{entry: entry, issuer_key: issuer_key} = target, precedents, manual) do
    row = Map.take(target, [:entry, :document_id, :tax_status])

    case Map.fetch(manual, {entry.id, issuer_key}) do
      {:ok, decision} -> {:matched, row |> Map.merge(decision) |> Map.put(:source, :manual)}
      :error -> classify_from_history(row, Map.get(precedents, {entry.user_id, issuer_key}, []))
    end
  end

  defp classify_from_history(%{entry: entry} = row, history) do
    case history |> Enum.map(&completed_booking(entry, &1)) |> Enum.uniq() do
      [] ->
        {:unmatched, Map.put(row, :reason, :no_history)}

      [{category, need_or_want}] ->
        precedent_count = history |> Enum.map(& &1.count) |> Enum.sum()

        {:matched,
         Map.merge(row, %{
           category: category,
           need_or_want: need_or_want,
           precedent_count: precedent_count,
           source: :precedent
         })}

      _conflicting ->
        {:unmatched, Map.put(row, :reason, :conflicting_history)}
    end
  end

  # Precedents only need to agree on what the entry is missing.
  defp completed_booking(entry, precedent) do
    {entry.category || precedent.category, entry.need_or_want || precedent.need_or_want}
  end

  defp apply_matches(_matched, false), do: %{applied: [], failed: []}

  defp apply_matches(matched, true) do
    results = Enum.map(matched, &{&1, apply_match(&1)})

    %{
      applied: for({match, {:ok, _}} <- results, do: match),
      failed:
        for({match, {:error, changeset}} <- results) do
          %{match: match, errors: changeset.errors}
        end
    }
  end

  defp apply_match(%{source: :manual, entry: entry} = match) do
    Accounting.post_entry(
      entry,
      entry.user_id,
      match.category,
      match.need_or_want,
      entry.notes,
      %{"status" => match.tax_status}
    )
  end

  defp apply_match(%{source: :precedent} = match) do
    Multi.new()
    |> Multi.update(:entry, booking_changeset(match))
    |> Multi.insert(:event, &event_changeset(&1.entry, match))
    |> Repo.transaction()
    |> case do
      {:ok, changes} -> {:ok, changes}
      {:error, _step, changeset, _changes} -> {:error, changeset}
    end
  end

  defp booking_changeset(%{entry: entry} = match) do
    entry
    |> JournalEntry.changeset_for_categorize(%{
      category: match.category,
      need_or_want: match.need_or_want,
      status: "posted"
    })
    |> Ecto.Changeset.force_change(:updated_at, entry.updated_at)
  end

  defp event_changeset(booked_entry, %{entry: previous} = match) do
    Accounting.posted_event_changeset(booked_entry, match.tax_status, %{
      source: @source,
      precedent_count: match.precedent_count,
      previous_status: previous.status,
      previous_category: previous.category,
      previous_need_or_want: previous.need_or_want
    })
  end

  defp format_match(%{entry: entry} = match, verb) do
    "#{verb} entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) as #{match.category} / #{match.need_or_want} " <>
      match_origin(match) <> "."
  end

  defp match_origin(%{source: :manual, tax_status: tax_status}),
    do: "from a manual decision, tax status #{tax_status}"

  defp match_origin(%{source: :precedent, precedent_count: count}),
    do: "from #{count} earlier posting(s)"

  defp format_unmatched(%{entry: entry, document_id: document_id, reason: reason}) do
    "Book by hand: entry #{entry.id} (#{entry.issuer}) at /documents/#{document_id}: " <>
      unmatched_reason(reason) <> "."
  end

  defp unmatched_reason(:no_history), do: "no earlier posting from this issuer"
  defp unmatched_reason(:conflicting_history), do: "earlier postings disagree"

  defp format_failure(%{match: %{entry: entry}, errors: errors}) do
    "Failed entry #{entry.id}: #{inspect(errors)}"
  end
end

  The `ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope` allows public interfaces to receive

  end-user, and if so, which user. Additionally, such a scope can carry fields
  such as "super user" or other privileges for use as authorization, or to
  ensure specific code paths can only be access for a given scope.

  It is useful for logging as well as for scoping pubsub subscriptions and
  broadcasts when a caller subscribes to an interface or performs a particular
  action.

  Feel free to extend the fields on this struct to fit the needs of
  growing application requirements.
  """

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}

2	  @moduledoc """
3	  User-scoped activity assembled from document-processing and posting records.
4	
5	  Each item represents the document's current place in the workflow. Documents
6	  with no extraction are shown as processing; extraction and review state then
7	  determines whether an item needs review, has failed, or has been posted.

12	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document

14	  @doc """
15	  Lists the newest activity for the scope, ordered by the latest user-visible
16	  workflow transition.
17	  """
18	  def list_recent(%Scope{} = scope, opts \\ []) do
19	    limit = Keyword.get(opts, :limit, 10)
20	
21	    scope
22	    |> Documents.list_documents()
23	    |> Enum.map(&to_activity_item/1)
24	    |> Enum.sort_by(& &1.occurred_at, {:desc, DateTime})
25	    |> maybe_take(limit)
26	  end
27	
28	  defp maybe_take(items, :all), do: items
29	  defp maybe_take(items, limit), do: Enum.take(items, limit)
30	
31	  defp to_activity_item(%Document{} = document) do
32	    content = List.first(document.extracted_content)
33	    decision = content && content.review_decision
34	    data = effective_activity_data(content, decision)
35	
36	    %{
37	      id: activity_id(document, content, decision),
38	      status: activity_status(content, decision),
39	      merchant: data && data.issuer,
40	      filename: document.filename,
41	      amount_cents: data && data.amount_to_pay_cents,
42	      currency: data && data.currency,
43	      invoice_no: data && data.invoice_number,
44	      error: activity_error(content, decision),
45	      occurred_at: activity_timestamp(document, content, decision),
46	      review_id: decision && decision.id,
47	      document_id: document.id
48	    }
49	  end
50	
51	  defp effective_activity_data(_content, %{decision_data: data}) when not is_nil(data),
52	    do: data
53	
54	  defp effective_activity_data(_content, %{original_data: data}) when not is_nil(data),
55	    do: data
56	
57	  defp effective_activity_data(%{extracted_data: data}, _decision) when not is_nil(data),
58	    do: data
59

61

63	  defp activity_status(%{status: "failed"}, _decision), do: "failed"
64	
65	  defp activity_status(_content, %{review_status: status}) when status in ["approved", "amended"],
66	    do: "posted"
67	
68	  defp activity_status(_content, %{review_status: "rejected"}), do: "failed"
69	  defp activity_status(_content, _decision), do: "review"

72	    Map.get(error_details, "message") || Map.get(error_details, :message) || "Processing failed"
73	  end

82	        content -> content.updated_at
83	        true -> document.updated_at
84	      end

  @moduledoc """
  User-scoped activity assembled from document-processing and posting records.

  Each item represents the document's current place in the workflow. Documents
  with no extraction are shown as processing; extraction and review state then
  determines whether an item needs review, has failed, or has been posted.

  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents
  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document

  @doc """
  Lists the newest activity for the scope, ordered by the latest user-visible
  workflow transition.
  """
  def list_recent(%Scope{} = scope, opts \\ []) do
    limit = Keyword.get(opts, :limit, 10)

    scope
    |> Documents.list_documents()
    |> Enum.map(&to_activity_item/1)
    |> Enum.sort_by(& &1.occurred_at, {:desc, DateTime})
    |> maybe_take(limit)
  end

  defp maybe_take(items, :all), do: items
  defp maybe_take(items, limit), do: Enum.take(items, limit)

  defp to_activity_item(%Document{} = document) do
    content = List.first(document.extracted_content)
    decision = content && content.review_decision
    data = effective_activity_data(content, decision)

    %{
      id: activity_id(document, content, decision),
      status: activity_status(content, decision),
      merchant: data && data.issuer,
      filename: document.filename,
      amount_cents: data && data.amount_to_pay_cents,
      currency: data && data.currency,
      invoice_no: data && data.invoice_number,
      error: activity_error(content, decision),
      occurred_at: activity_timestamp(document, content, decision),
      review_id: decision && decision.id,
      document_id: document.id
    }
  end

  defp effective_activity_data(_content, %{decision_data: data}) when not is_nil(data),
    do: data

  defp effective_activity_data(_content, %{original_data: data}) when not is_nil(data),
    do: data

  defp effective_activity_data(%{extracted_data: data}, _decision) when not is_nil(data),
    do: data

  defp effective_activity_data(_content, _decision), do: nil

  defp activity_status(nil, _decision), do: "processing"
  defp activity_status(%{status: "failed"}, _decision), do: "failed"

  defp activity_status(_content, %{review_status: status}) when status in ["approved", "amended"],
    do: "posted"

  defp activity_status(_content, %{review_status: "rejected"}), do: "failed"
  defp activity_status(_content, _decision), do: "review"

  defp activity_error(%{error_details: error_details}, _decision) when is_map(error_details) do
    Map.get(error_details, "message") || Map.get(error_details, :message) || "Processing failed"
  end

  defp activity_error(_content, %{rejection_reason: reason}) when is_binary(reason), do: reason
  defp activity_error(_content, _decision), do: nil

  defp activity_timestamp(document, content, decision) do
    timestamp =
      cond do
        decision && decision.review_completed_at -> decision.review_completed_at
        content -> content.updated_at
        true -> document.updated_at
      end

    as_utc_datetime(timestamp)
  end

  defp as_utc_datetime(%DateTime{} = timestamp), do: timestamp

  defp as_utc_datetime(%NaiveDateTime{} = timestamp) do
    DateTime.from_naive!(timestamp, "Etc/UTC")
  end

  defp activity_id(_document, _content, %{id: id}), do: "review-#{id}"
  defp activity_id(_document, %{id: id}, _decision), do: "extraction-#{id}"
  defp activity_id(%{id: id}, _content, _decision), do: "document-#{id}"
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Documents.FingerprintBackfill do
  @moduledoc """
  Idempotent, online backfill of exact-byte fingerprints for rows created
  before fingerprints existed.

  1. Every document with a null `content_sha256` is read through
     `ZaimuTomo.Storage` and hashed. A missing or unreadable object is
     reported and left null; no other value is ever stored in its place.
  2. Every journal entry with a null `source_document_sha256` receives its
     source document's fingerprint, one entry per update and oldest first, so
     the first posting of a file keeps it. A unique-index violation (a same-user
     historical duplicate) affects only that row: it is reported with the entry
     it collides with and left null. Ledger rows are never deleted or merged.

  A human may resolve a reported collision by listing the later entry in
  `:confirm_reuse`; the backfill then sets its digest and
  `source_file_reuse_confirmed` in one update. This is the only permitted
  update of an existing entry's fingerprint (spec D7), so it must run before
  any database-level immutability trigger on `journal_entries` exists, or that
  trigger must allow it.

  The report contains row IDs and counts only, never bytes or digests. The
  partial unique index already exists, so concurrent postings cannot create a
  same-user duplicate while this runs.
  """

  import Ecto.Query, warn: false

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Fingerprint
  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision
  alias ZaimuTomo.Storage

  @type collision :: %{journal_entry_id: integer(), user_id: integer(), conflicts_with: integer()}

  @type summary :: %{
          documents_hashed: non_neg_integer(),
          documents_already_complete: non_neg_integer(),
          missing_objects: [integer()],
          read_failures: [%{document_id: integer(), reason: term()}],
          entries_updated: non_neg_integer(),
          entries_already_complete: non_neg_integer(),
          entries_reuse_confirmed: [integer()],
          entries_source_unavailable: [integer()],
          collisions: [collision()],
          unused_reuse_confirmations: [integer()]
        }

  @doc """
  Runs the backfill.

  Returns `{:ok, summary}` when historical coverage is complete, and
  `{:error, summary}` when any object is missing or unreadable, an entry's
  source fingerprint is unavailable, or a collision awaits human review.

  Options:

    * `:confirm_reuse` — journal entry IDs a human confirmed as legitimate
      reuses of an already posted file. Applied only to an entry whose plain
      update collides; otherwise reported as unused.
  """
  @spec run(keyword()) :: {:ok, summary()} | {:error, summary()}
  def run(opts \\ []) do
    confirm_reuse = opts |> Keyword.get(:confirm_reuse, []) |> MapSet.new()

    summary =
      empty_summary()
      |> backfill_documents()
      |> backfill_journal_entries(confirm_reuse)
      |> finalize(confirm_reuse)

    if complete?(summary), do: {:ok, summary}, else: {:error, summary}
  end

  @spec format_summary(summary()) :: String.t()
  def format_summary(summary) do
    [
      "Fingerprint backfill summary: " <>
        "documents_hashed=#{summary.documents_hashed} " <>
        "documents_already_complete=#{summary.documents_already_complete} " <>
        "missing_objects=#{length(summary.missing_objects)} " <>
        "read_failures=#{length(summary.read_failures)} " <>
        "entries_updated=#{summary.entries_updated} " <>
        "entries_already_complete=#{summary.entries_already_complete} " <>
        "entries_reuse_confirmed=#{length(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed)} " <>
        "entries_source_unavailable=#{length(summary.entries_source_unavailable)} " <>
        "collisions=#{length(summary.collisions)}"
      | Enum.map(summary.missing_objects, &"Missing object for document #{&1}") ++
          Enum.map(summary.read_failures, &format_read_failure/1) ++
          Enum.map(summary.entries_source_unavailable, &format_source_unavailable/1) ++
          Enum.map(summary.collisions, &format_collision/1) ++
          Enum.map(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed, &"Confirmed reuse for journal entry #{&1}") ++
          Enum.map(summary.unused_reuse_confirmations, &format_unused_confirmation/1) ++
          coverage_line(summary)
    ]
    |> Enum.join("\n")
  end

  # -- Documents ---------------------------------------------------------------

  defp backfill_documents(summary) do
    already_complete =
      Repo.aggregate(from(d in Document, where: not is_nil(d.content_sha256)), :count)

    from(d in Document,
      where: is_nil(d.content_sha256),
      order_by: [asc: d.id],
      select: {d.id, d.object_key}
    )
    |> Repo.all()
    |> Enum.reduce(%{summary | documents_already_complete: already_complete}, &hash_document/2)
  end

  defp hash_document({document_id, object_key}, summary) do
    case Storage.read_object(object_key) do
      {:ok, body} ->
        # Conditional on the same key and a still-null digest, so a concurrent
        # file replacement (which records its own digest) is never overwritten.
        {count, _} =
          from(d in Document,
            where:
              d.id == ^document_id and d.object_key == ^object_key and
                is_nil(d.content_sha256)
          )
          |> Repo.update_all(set: [content_sha256: Fingerprint.sha256(body)])

        if count == 1,
          do: %{summary | documents_hashed: summary.documents_hashed + 1},
          else: %{summary | documents_already_complete: summary.documents_already_complete + 1}

      {:error, :not_found} ->
        %{summary | missing_objects: [document_id | summary.missing_objects]}

      {:error, reason} ->
        failure = %{document_id: document_id, reason: reason}
        %{summary | read_failures: [failure | summary.read_failures]}
    end
  end

  # -- Journal entries ---------------------------------------------------------

  defp backfill_journal_entries(summary, confirm_reuse) do
    already_complete =
      Repo.aggregate(
        from(je in JournalEntry, where: not is_nil(je.source_document_sha256)),
        :count
      )

    from(je in JournalEntry,
      left_join: rd in ReviewDecision,
      on: rd.id == je.review_decision_id,
      left_join: ec in ExtractedContent,
      on: ec.id == rd.extracted_content_id and ec.user_id == je.user_id,
      left_join: d in Document,
      on: d.id == ec.document_id and d.user_id == je.user_id,
      where: is_nil(je.source_document_sha256),
      order_by: [asc: je.inserted_at, asc: je.id],
      select: {je, d.content_sha256}
    )
    |> Repo.all()
    |> Enum.reduce(
      %{summary | entries_already_complete: already_complete},
      &backfill_entry(&1, &2, confirm_reuse)
    )
  end

  defp backfill_entry({entry, nil}, summary, _confirm_reuse) do
    %{summary | entries_source_unavailable: [entry.id | summary.entries_source_unavailable]}
  end

  defp backfill_entry({entry, digest}, summary, confirm_reuse) do
    case update_entry(entry, %{source_document_sha256: digest}) do
      {:ok, _entry} ->
        %{summary | entries_updated: summary.entries_updated + 1}

      {:error, :collision} ->
        if MapSet.member?(confirm_reuse, entry.id) do
          confirm_reuse(entry, digest, summary)
        else
          collision = %{
            journal_entry_id: entry.id,
            user_id: entry.user_id,
            conflicts_with: conflicting_entry_id(entry.user_id, digest)
          }

          %{summary | collisions: [collision | summary.collisions]}
        end
    end
  end

  defp confirm_reuse(entry, digest, summary) do
    attrs = %{source_document_sha256: digest, source_file_reuse_confirmed: true}

    # A confirmed reuse is outside the partial index, so it cannot collide.
    {:ok, _entry} = update_entry(entry, attrs)
    %{summary | entries_reuse_confirmed: [entry.id | summary.entries_reuse_confirmed]}
  end

  # The fingerprint is derived metadata, not an edit: keep `updated_at`, which
  # orders the user's journal list.
  defp update_entry(entry, attrs) do
    entry
    |> JournalEntry.changeset_for_fingerprint_backfill(attrs)
    |> Ecto.Changeset.force_change(:updated_at, entry.updated_at)
    |> Repo.update()
    |> case do
      {:ok, entry} ->
        {:ok, entry}

      {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset} ->
        if source_file_collision?(changeset),
          do: {:error, :collision},
          else: raise(Ecto.InvalidChangesetError, action: :update, changeset: changeset)
    end
  end

  defp source_file_collision?(%Ecto.Changeset{errors: errors}) do
    Enum.any?(errors, fn {_field, {_message, opts}} ->
      opts[:constraint] == :unique and
        opts[:constraint_name] == JournalEntry.duplicate_source_file_index()
    end)
  end

  defp conflicting_entry_id(user_id, digest) do
    from(je in JournalEntry,
      where: je.user_id == ^user_id and je.source_document_sha256 == ^digest,
      where: not je.source_file_reuse_confirmed,
      select: je.id,
      limit: 1
    )
    |> Repo.one()
  end

  # -- Summary -----------------------------------------------------------------

  defp empty_summary do
    %{
      documents_hashed: 0,
      documents_already_complete: 0,
      missing_objects: [],
      read_failures: [],
      entries_updated: 0,
      entries_already_complete: 0,
      entries_reuse_confirmed: [],
      entries_source_unavailable: [],
      collisions: [],
      unused_reuse_confirmations: []
    }
  end

  defp finalize(summary, confirm_reuse) do
    applied = MapSet.new(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed)

    %{
      summary
      | missing_objects: Enum.reverse(summary.missing_objects),
        read_failures: Enum.reverse(summary.read_failures),
        entries_reuse_confirmed: Enum.reverse(summary.entries_reuse_confirmed),
        entries_source_unavailable: Enum.reverse(summary.entries_source_unavailable),
        collisions: Enum.reverse(summary.collisions),
        unused_reuse_confirmations: confirm_reuse |> MapSet.difference(applied) |> Enum.sort()
    }
  end

  defp complete?(summary) do
    summary.missing_objects == [] and summary.read_failures == [] and
      summary.entries_source_unavailable == [] and summary.collisions == []
  end

  defp coverage_line(summary) do
    if complete?(summary),
      do: ["Historical fingerprint coverage is complete."],
      else: ["Historical fingerprint coverage is INCOMPLETE; see the rows above."]
  end

  defp format_read_failure(%{document_id: id, reason: reason}),
    do: "Read failure for document #{id}: #{inspect(reason)}"

  defp format_source_unavailable(id),
    do: "Journal entry #{id}: source document fingerprint unavailable"

  defp format_collision(%{journal_entry_id: id, user_id: user_id, conflicts_with: other}),
    do:
      "Collision: journal entry #{id} (user #{user_id}) has the same source file as " <>
        "entry #{other}; left null for human ledger review"

  defp format_unused_confirmation(id),
    do: "Reuse confirmation for journal entry #{id} not applied (no collision to resolve)"
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.FinancialAccounts do
  @moduledoc """
  Financial accounts and their dated balance snapshots.
  """

  import Ecto.Query, warn: false

  alias Ecto.Multi
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope
  alias ZaimuTomo.FinancialAccounts.{BalanceSnapshot, FinancialAccount}
  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo

  def subscribe_financial_accounts(%Scope{} = scope) do
    Phoenix.PubSub.subscribe(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, topic(scope))
  end

  def list_financial_accounts(%Scope{} = scope) do
    FinancialAccount
    |> where(user_id: ^scope.user.id)
    |> order_by([account], asc: account.name)
    |> Repo.all()
  end

  def list_financial_accounts_with_latest_balance(%Scope{} = scope) do
    latest_balances =
      scope
      |> latest_balance_snapshots()
      |> Map.new(&{&1.financial_account_id, &1})

    Enum.map(list_financial_accounts(scope), fn account ->
      %{account: account, balance_snapshot: Map.get(latest_balances, account.id)}
    end)
  end

  def list_net_worth_by_currency(%Scope{} = scope) do
    scope
    |> list_financial_accounts_with_latest_balance()
    |> Enum.reject(&is_nil(&1.balance_snapshot))
    |> Enum.group_by(& &1.account.currency)
    |> Enum.map(fn {currency, accounts} ->
      %{
        currency: currency,
        total_cents: Enum.sum_by(accounts, & &1.balance_snapshot.amount_cents),
        account_count: length(accounts)
      }
    end)
    |> Enum.sort_by(& &1.currency)
  end

  def list_savings_accounts_with_latest_balance(%Scope{} = scope) do
    scope
    |> list_financial_accounts_with_latest_balance()
    |> Enum.filter(&(&1.account.account_type == :savings))
  end

  def list_cash_accounts_with_latest_balance(%Scope{} = scope) do
    scope
    |> list_financial_accounts_with_latest_balance()
    |> Enum.filter(&(&1.account.account_type == :cash))
  end

  def list_investment_accounts_with_latest_balance(%Scope{} = scope) do
    scope
    |> list_financial_accounts_with_latest_balance()
    |> Enum.filter(&(&1.account.account_type == :investment))
  end

  def get_financial_account!(%Scope{} = scope, id) do
    Repo.get_by!(FinancialAccount, id: id, user_id: scope.user.id)
  end

  def create_financial_account_with_balance(%Scope{} = scope, account_attrs, balance_attrs) do
    multi =
      Multi.new()
      |> Multi.insert(
        :financial_account,
        FinancialAccount.changeset(%FinancialAccount{}, account_attrs, scope)
      )
      |> Multi.insert(:balance_snapshot, fn %{financial_account: account} ->
        BalanceSnapshot.changeset(
          %BalanceSnapshot{},
          Map.put(balance_attrs, :financial_account_id, account.id)
        )
      end)

    case Repo.transaction(multi) do
      {:ok, %{financial_account: account, balance_snapshot: snapshot}} ->
        broadcast(scope, {:created, account})
        {:ok, %{account: account, balance_snapshot: snapshot}}

      {:error, _operation, changeset, _changes} ->
        {:error, changeset}
    end
  end

  def update_financial_account(%Scope{} = scope, %FinancialAccount{} = account, attrs) do
    true = account.user_id == scope.user.id

    case account |> FinancialAccount.changeset(attrs, scope) |> Repo.update() do
      {:ok, updated_account} ->
        broadcast(scope, {:updated, updated_account})
        {:ok, updated_account}

      {:error, changeset} ->
        {:error, changeset}
    end
  end

  def delete_financial_account(%Scope{} = scope, %FinancialAccount{} = account) do
    true = account.user_id == scope.user.id

    case Repo.delete(account) do
      {:ok, deleted_account} ->
        broadcast(scope, {:deleted, deleted_account})
        {:ok, deleted_account}

      {:error, changeset} ->
        {:error, changeset}
    end
  end

  def change_financial_account(%Scope{} = scope, %FinancialAccount{} = account, attrs \\ %{}) do
    true = account.user_id == scope.user.id
    FinancialAccount.changeset(account, attrs, scope)
  end

  def list_balance_snapshots(%Scope{} = scope, %FinancialAccount{} = account) do
    true = account.user_id == scope.user.id

    BalanceSnapshot
    |> where(financial_account_id: ^account.id)
    |> order_by([snapshot],
      desc: snapshot.recorded_on,
      desc: snapshot.inserted_at,
      desc: snapshot.id
    )
    |> Repo.all()
  end

  @doc "Returns the current user's balance snapshots in the inclusive date range."
  def list_balance_history(%Scope{} = scope, %Date{} = start_date, %Date{} = end_date) do
    scope
    |> scoped_balance_snapshots()
    |> where(
      [snapshot, _account],
      snapshot.recorded_on >= ^start_date and snapshot.recorded_on <= ^end_date
    )
    |> order_by([snapshot, _account],
      asc: snapshot.financial_account_id,
      asc: snapshot.recorded_on,
      asc: snapshot.inserted_at,
      asc: snapshot.id
    )
    |> Repo.all()
  end

  @doc "Returns each user's account's latest snapshot before the history window."
  def list_balance_history_baseline(%Scope{} = scope, %Date{} = before_date) do
    scope
    |> scoped_balance_snapshots()
    |> where([snapshot, _account], snapshot.recorded_on < ^before_date)
    |> latest_balance_query()
    |> Repo.all()
  end

  def record_balance(%Scope{} = scope, %FinancialAccount{} = account, attrs) do
    true = account.user_id == scope.user.id

    result =
      attrs
      |> Map.put(:financial_account_id, account.id)
      |> then(&BalanceSnapshot.changeset(%BalanceSnapshot{}, &1))
      |> Repo.insert()

    case result do
      {:ok, snapshot} ->
        broadcast(scope, {:balance_recorded, snapshot})
        {:ok, snapshot}

      {:error, changeset} ->
        {:error, changeset}
    end
  end

  def change_balance_snapshot(%BalanceSnapshot{} = snapshot, attrs \\ %{}) do
    BalanceSnapshot.changeset(snapshot, attrs)
  end

  defp latest_balance_snapshots(%Scope{} = scope) do
    scope
    |> scoped_balance_snapshots()
    |> latest_balance_query()
    |> Repo.all()
  end

  defp latest_balance_query(query) do
    query
    |> distinct([snapshot, _account], snapshot.financial_account_id)
    |> order_by([snapshot, _account],
      asc: snapshot.financial_account_id,
      desc: snapshot.recorded_on,
      desc: snapshot.inserted_at,
      desc: snapshot.id
    )
  end

  defp scoped_balance_snapshots(%Scope{} = scope) do
    from(snapshot in BalanceSnapshot,
      join: account in FinancialAccount,
      on: account.id == snapshot.financial_account_id,
      where: account.user_id == ^scope.user.id
    )
  end

  defp topic(scope), do: "user:#{scope.user.id}:financial_accounts"

  defp broadcast(scope, message),
    do: Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, topic(scope), message)
end
